_comment: Eval 005: each passage states the relation in NON-closed form, so building the usable card requires a real symbolic derivation (divide+simplify, or solve-for-target). purpose names the target quantity without leaking the closed form.

astro-025.purpose: computing the flight-path angle (angle between the velocity vector and the local horizontal) at a given true anomaly on a Keplerian orbit of known eccentricity

astro-037.purpose: computing the semi-major axis of an orbit from its orbital period and the central body's gravitational parameter mu

astro-038.purpose: computing the orbital speed at a given radius r on an orbit of semi-major axis a around a body of gravitational parameter mu
